stories.head: Meta brings memory and focus to specialized models
stories.fact: Meta announces specialized models for Muse and Meta AI with Active Memory and Active Focus; its own Active Memory evaluation reports 90% versus 76% for the previous model.
stories.why: Test stale-context rejection and requirement retention, not just recall, before trusting a persistent research assistant.
stories.unc: Vendor evaluation, not an independently validated finance benchmark; availability and performance can vary.
labels: Specialized models for Muse and Meta AI
stories.alt: Four labels describe specialized models, relevant memory, task recovery and Meta’s reported memory evaluation.

stories.head: FINCOSMOS tests hidden requirements and point-in-time correctness
stories.fact: FINCOSMOS evaluates financial agents that must acquire web data, elicit a hidden strategy and backtest under a cutoff. Authors report no accepted session among 150 sessions: user sign-off did not survive programmatic checks.
stories.why: Turn ambiguous strategy requests into explicit specifications and verify data timing and recomputed metrics independently.
stories.unc: Preprint and benchmark-specific findings; simulated users and tasks do not establish universal failure rates.
labels: User approval + all veto checks pass
stories.alt: Conceptual workflow separates requirement elicitation, timestamped data, metric recomputation and independent acceptance gates.

stories.head: Friday rebound leaves Nasdaq with a fourth weekly decline
stories.fact: Reuters reports Friday gains of 1.09% for the Nasdaq and 0.32% for the S&P 500, while the Dow fell 0.46%. The Nasdaq still posted its fourth consecutive weekly decline.
stories.why: Distinguish a one-session rebound from trend repair; stress Monday gaps and execution costs.
stories.unc: Reported closing figures were described as unofficial; index changes are not ETF returns or executable quotes.
stories.credit: Reuters via Fidelity, November 6, 2026 close report
stories.alt: Zero-centered bars show Friday index changes: Dow minus 0.46%, S&P 500 plus 0.32%, Nasdaq plus 1.09%.

stories.head: October payrolls rise 165,000; unemployment is 4.1%
stories.fact: BLS reports October nonfarm payroll growth of 165,000 and unemployment of 4.1%, which it characterizes as little changed.
stories.why: Model labor growth and revisions alongside inflation; do not infer the next Fed decision from one headline.
stories.unc: Initial estimates are revised; establishment payrolls and household unemployment are different surveys.
stories.credit: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, November 6, 2026
stories.alt: Separate labels show October payroll growth of 165,000 and unemployment of 4.1%, with a revision caveat.

stories.head: NYT reportedly in exclusive talks for Letterboxd
stories.date: Reuters report November 6 UTC; underlying report November 5, 2026
stories.fact: Reuters, citing a New York Times report, says the Times Company is in exclusive talks to acquire Letterboxd at about $330 million. No agreement has been reached.
stories.why: Evaluate subscriber adjacency and integration economics separately from a speculative acquisition premium.
stories.unc: Unconfirmed talks; price and completion may change or the deal may fail.
stories.alt: Clearly labeled unconfirmed acquisition talks identify NYT Company, Letterboxd, reported value and absence of an agreement.
